content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To go to school today, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Check the weather forecast on your phone (30 seconds)
Step 2. Select a pair of clean socks (1 minute)
Step 3. Iron your school uniform shirt (6 minutes)
Step 4. Pack your lunch box into your bag (2 minutes)
Step 5. Prepare a ham and cheese sandwich (5 minutes)
Step 6. Put on your school uniform (4 minutes)
Step 7. Take a quick morning shower (10 minutes)
Step 8. Dry your hair with a towel (3 minutes)
Step 9. Gather ingredients for lunch from the fridge (2 minutes)
Step 10. Find your matching school shoes (4 minutes)
Step 11. Wake up and get out of bed (2 minutes)
Step 12. Decide whether to bring an umbrella (1 minute)
Step 13. Locate your house keys (2 minutes)
Step 14. Check your school timetable (2 minutes)
Step 15. Find your gym clothes (3 minutes)
Step 16. Double-check your homework is in your folder (5 minutes)
Step 17. Use the bathroom (3 minutes)
Step 18. Walk out the front door (1 minute)
Step 19. Pick out an outfit based on the weather (4 minutes)
Step 20. Attach your keys to your lanyard (30 seconds)
Step 21. Put on your undershirt (1 minute)
Step 22. Tie your shoelaces (1 minute)
Step 23. Grab your bus pass from the dresser (1 minute)
Step 24. Look for your wallet (3 minutes)
Step 25. Apply deodorant (30 seconds)
Step 26. Find your wristwatch (1 minute)
Step 27. Tuck in your shirt (1 minute)
Step 28. Put on your trousers (2 minutes)
Step 29. Pack your school bag (5 minutes)
Step 30. Check that you have your phone charger (2 minutes)
Step 31. Brush your teeth (2 minutes)
Step 32. Put your bus pass in your pocket (30 seconds)
Step 33. Refill your reusable water bottle (2 minutes)
Step 34. Check the laundry basket for your gym bag (2 minutes)
Step 35. Grab a jacket if it is cold (1 minute)
Step 36. Stretch your muscles (5 minutes)
Step 37. Put on your school blazer (1 minute)
Step 38. Check your appearance in the mirror (2 minutes)
Step 39. Find a clean face mask (30 seconds)
Step 40. Look for your glasses (2 minutes)
Step 41. Turn off your alarm clock (10 seconds)
Step 42. Do some light morning exercises (10 minutes)
Step 43. Lock the bedroom door (30 seconds)
Step 44. Place the water bottle in the side pocket (30 seconds)
Step 45. Ensure all textbooks are packed (4 minutes)
Step 46. Final check of your reflection (1 minute)
Step 47. Pack your gym bag (3 minutes)
Step 48. Check your reflection in the hallway mirror (30 seconds)
Step 49. Put on your backpack (30 seconds)
Step 50. Apply hair gel (2 minutes)
